usage: ai-effort-ledger setup [--store FOLDER] [--json] [--language {en,it}] [-h] [--label TEXT]
                              [--schedule {yes,no}] [--native-logs TOOL=FOLDER] [--time HOUR]

prepare the ledger on a machine

options:
  --store FOLDER             use another store folder for this command only
  --json                     write the result as one JSON document
  --language {en,it}         the language of the output
  -h, --help                 show this help message and exit
  --label TEXT               the label of the machine
  --schedule {yes,no}        yes: create the scheduled ingestion without asking; no: never
                             create it
  --native-logs TOOL=FOLDER  a folder of native logs of an agent tool, as tool=folder
  --time HOUR                the time of day of the scheduled ingestion
